source: Example sentences written for the sample word lists by the app's builder (generated, not from the teacher). Each must be reviewed and may be edited by the parent before approval.

vocabulary.Produce: We bought fresh produce like apples and carrots at the farmers market.
vocabulary.Exception: Our class has no homework on Fridays, but this week is an exception because of the science fair.
vocabulary.Installment: Grandma pays for her new car with one installment every month.
vocabulary.Peculiar: The cat made a peculiar noise that sounded like a squeaky door.
vocabulary.Employee: The employee at the pet store helped us choose food for our fish.
vocabulary.Fortunate: We were fortunate that the rain stopped right before our picnic.
vocabulary.Ignorant: I was ignorant about how bees make honey until we read a book about it.
vocabulary.Melancholy: The rainy day gave Sam a melancholy feeling, so he stayed inside and looked out the window.
vocabulary.Trustworthy: Lena is trustworthy because she always keeps her promises.
vocabulary.Constellations: On the camping trip, we looked up and found three constellations in the night sky.
vocabulary.Irritating: The buzzing fly was irritating while I tried to read my book.
vocabulary.Distracted: The puppy outside the window distracted me from my math homework.

spelling.rushed: We rushed to the bus stop so we would not be late.
spelling.blasted: The rocket blasted off into the sky.
spelling.washed: I washed my hands before dinner.
spelling.winked: Grandpa winked at me when he told the joke.
spelling.opened: She opened the gift and smiled.
spelling.buzzed: A bee buzzed around the flowers in the garden.
spelling.asked: Tom asked his teacher for help with the puzzle.
spelling.called: Mom called us inside for lunch.
spelling.lifted: Dad lifted the heavy box onto the shelf.
spelling.landed: The airplane landed safely at the airport.
spelling.hunted: The owl hunted for mice in the dark field.
spelling.screamed: The fans screamed when their team scored a goal.
spelling.stepped: I stepped over the puddle on the sidewalk.
spelling.handed: The teacher handed each student a new pencil.
spelling.crashed: The waves crashed against the rocks.
